notes.title: Users Feedbacks and suggestions implementation
notes.notes:
Hey gamers!
Due to some problems I had a few weeks delay in updating the game
I have read all of your reviews, these reviews are huge support and help me to improve the game, I plan to implement all of them in the game.

Here are some of the new changes:

Tower Upgrade Details:
Now you can see the upgrade detail of each tower.

Level Difficulty:
The difficulty of the game has been balanced.

Easy, Normal or Hard:
All of the level mode are unlocked, you can select and play any mode you want!.



Any Feedback or suggestion is always valuable for me

notes.title: Level Balance, Bug Fixed & Graphic improvement
notes.notes:
Hello Gamers!!
If you play a level repeatedly,  the level will not become harder and harder.
There was a bug in the achievement claim button (!), We have solve it.
We have improved the graphic like adding shadow and etc. . . .

If you  have any problem within the game, post it in the discussion.

Thank you
